Marissa — thanks for the clear notes. A few clarifications from our side:

- PHI handling: any inference traffic that includes PHI must stay in our VPC or on-prem cluster; we cannot send PHI to shared hosted endpoints that mix other customers.
- Region: all data and backups must remain in the US (us-west region preferred).
- Retention: we require a 90-day default retention with the ability to purge specific records on request; audit of purge requests is required.
- Logging / Audit: we need immutable audit logs (request ID, timestamp, actor) and the ability to export logs for quarterly audits.
- Keys: production keys must be customer-managed (KMS/HSM).
- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II report + encryption attestations needed during procurement.

Can you update the MAP to reflect the VPC/on-prem requirement for PHI flows? Also, please surface any constraints around redaction versus not storing PHI at all — our legal team will prefer not storing PHI post-inference if feasible.

I can review the updated MAP and questionnaire on a follow-up call. 2026-07-01 at 11:00am PT works for me.

John / team — thanks for the clear constraints. A few technical notes from the SE side to help update the MAP and pick the right POC approach:

- Deployment options: Redwood Private (VPC) supports single-tenant model serving within your AWS account and keeps traffic within your VPC; we also offer an on-prem package for fully air-gapped environments. For PHI flows, we recommend the VPC deployment unless you have strict air-gap requirements.
- Keys: we integrate with AWS KMS and can support customer-managed CMKs / external HSMs for key control.
- Retention & purge: the serving runtime can be configured to retain inference inputs/outputs for a configurable window (e.g., 0/30/90 days) and supports programmatic purge APIs. Purge requests are logged and we can provide an exportable purge audit CSV.
- Audit logs: we generate per-request audit records (request_id, model_version, timestamp, actor, originating IP) and can ship logs to your S3 bucket or SIEM. Logs are immutable on our side for the retention window; exports for audits are supported.
- PHI redaction: we have optional model-level redaction filters and can combine pre-routing redaction with the private deployment to minimize PHI in logs; note that redaction effectiveness depends on schema and prompt design — we'll include evaluation metrics in the POC.

Action items (SE):
- I'll draft a technical appendix for the MAP covering deployment options, KMS/HSM integration steps, retention configurations, and log export paths — target: 2026-06-22 (attachment: retention-and-logs-tech-spec.pdf).
- Prepare POC checklist and infra playbook for VPC setup — target: 2026-06-29.

If you want, I can include a high-level network diagram in the tech appendix showing where audit logs are stored and how keys are scoped.
